date_note: Date of the minister's statement to Parliament, as reported by the Rio Times on 24 November; the outages began earlier.
exec: Morocco's finance minister says the national public procurement portal was taken offline on purpose for IT security; bidders' deadlines were moved.
plain: Morocco's finance minister told Parliament that repeated outages of the national public procurement portal were deliberate steps to strengthen IT security. Deadlines for bidders were moved.
summary: The Rio Times reports that Morocco's Minister of Economy, Finance and Public Performance, Fouzi Lekjaa, told Parliament on 23 November that the repeated outages of the national public procurement portal were intentional, measures taken 'deliberately' to strengthen IT security. He said the Treasury rescheduled deadlines and extended time limits so all bidders keep equal rights. The article says no attack on the portal has been confirmed.
title: Morocco's finance minister says procurement portal outages were deliberate security measures, the Rio Times reports

validation.note: Only the Rio Times (24 Nov) read; it relays the minister's statement to Parliament. No ministry or Treasury page found.
